answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 16 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 320 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The saffron test is the live device, the vertex test is the locked stake, and the zephyr test is the graded history no template can fake.
